source_caption_text:
Four years ago today, Kid Cudi released his album “Entergalactic” and its accompanying animated Netflix special 👀🔥

What are your favorite tracks from the project 🤔⁉️

It’s been 4 years since Kid Cudi released Entergalactic, pairing the album with an animated Netflix special that told the same story through music and visuals. It was a different kind of release for Cudi, blending his music with a full animated world.

The album leaned into love, vulnerability and a more uplifting side of Cudi. Songs like “Do What I Want” and “Willing to Trust” fit naturally into the story, giving the project a warm and dreamy feel from beginning to end.

Entergalactic showed Cudi stepping outside the usual album format and bringing his music into another medium. Four years later, it still stands out as one of the more unique projects of his career.
